authorityCeiling.basis: Boundary: "Binary state does not replace continuous ranking." HKRS weights and ranks; weighting is advisory, it takes no action itself, so its ceiling is recommend.

Role quote: "Weights relevance, confidence, cost, value, freshness, and risk." Weighting and ranking advise a decision; they do not take the decision, which maps to recommend in the Section 3.3 authority vocabulary.

capabilityFamilies.basis: Role quote: "Weights relevance, confidence, cost, value, freshness, and risk."

lifecycleStages.basis: Section 3.3 defines lifecycleMask as workflow stage and completion state but names no stages. The paper assigns no lifecycle stages to HKRS.

memoryPlanes.basis: Weights are computed at decision time in working scope; the paper assigns no stored memory plane to HKRS.

outputClasses.basis: Role quote: "Weights relevance, confidence, cost, value, freshness, and risk." Weights and scores are delivered as messages to the deciding organ.

permittedRoutes.basis: The paper defines routeMask semantics in Sections 3.2 and 3.3 but names no per-organ routes for HKRS.

paperBoundary: Binary state does not replace continuous ranking.
paperRole: Weights relevance, confidence, cost, value, freshness, and risk.
paperSource: N-Cell position paper, Section 4 mapping table, https://ncell-position-paper.pages.dev/, accessed 2026-11-14.
